# BPO Hive

> Managed B2B outbound and appointment setting for the USA, Canada and GCC. Campaigns start at USD 4,000 per month. Last updated 2026-10-06.

ACES means Analyze, Craft, Execute, Scale. A touchpoint is an outreach action, not a unique prospect or meeting. Cumulative results: 21,200+ appointments booked and $25M+ in client-attributed revenue. Founded in 2020, with operations in Cairo, Egypt and Dubai, UAE.
